use eframe::egui;
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn configurer_police(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    let candidats = [
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\trebuc.ttf",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\Candara.ttf",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\calibri.ttf",
        "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\verdana.ttf",
    ];
    for chemin in candidats {
        if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(chemin) {
            fonts.font_data.insert(
                "principale".to_string(),
                egui::FontData::from_owned(bytes),
            );
            fonts
                .families
                .entry(egui::FontFamily::Proportional)
                .or_default()
                .insert(0, "principale".to_string());
            break;
        }
    }
    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
    let mut style = (*ctx.style()).clone();
    style.text_styles.insert(
        egui::TextStyle::Body,
        egui::FontId::new(14.0, egui::FontFamily::Proportional),
    );
    style.text_styles.insert(
        egui::TextStyle::Button,
        egui::FontId::new(14.0, egui::FontFamily::Proportional),
    );
    style.text_styles.insert(
        egui::TextStyle::Heading,
        egui::FontId::new(19.0, egui::FontFamily::Proportional),
    );
    style.text_styles.insert(
        egui::TextStyle::Small,
        egui::FontId::new(11.0, egui::FontFamily::Proportional),
    );
    style.spacing.button_padding = egui::vec2(12.0, 7.0);
    style.spacing.item_spacing = egui::vec2(8.0, 7.0);
    style.visuals.widgets.inactive.rounding = egui::Rounding::same(8.0);
    style.visuals.widgets.hovered.rounding = egui::Rounding::same(8.0);
    style.visuals.widgets.active.rounding = egui::Rounding::same(8.0);
    ctx.set_style(style);
}

fn charger_icone_fenetre() -> Option<egui::IconData> {
    let chemin = PathBuf::from("images").join("logo.png");
    let bytes = std::fs::read(chemin).ok()?;
    let img = image::load_from_memory(&bytes).ok()?.to_rgba8();
    let (largeur, hauteur) = img.dimensions();
    Some(egui::IconData {
        rgba: img.into_raw(),
        width: largeur,
        height: hauteur,
    })
}

fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> {
    let session = persistence::charger_session();
    let mut viewport = egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
        .with_inner_size(session.window_size)
        .with_min_inner_size([900.0, 550.0])
        .with_title("Joinus");
    if let Some(icone) = charger_icone_fenetre() {
        viewport = viewport.with_icon(icone);
    }
    let options = eframe::NativeOptions {
        viewport,
        renderer: eframe::Renderer::Wgpu,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    eframe::run_native(
        "Joinus",
        options,
        Box::new(move |cc| {
            configurer_police(&cc.egui_ctx);
            Ok(Box::new(app::App::new(cc, session)))
        }),
    )
}

--- FICHIER : D:\Creation\Rust\Joinus\src\network.rs ---
use crate::pieces_jointes::PieceJointe;
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as BASE64, Engine};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::{IpAddr, Ipv4Addr, SocketAddr, TcpListener, TcpStream, UdpSocket};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::mpsc::{channel, Receiver, Sender};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::thread;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub const PORT_UDP: u16 = 42001;
pub const INTERVALLE_ANNONCE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
pub const TIMEOUT_PRESENCE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);
pub const LIMITE_MESSAGE_OCTETS: usize = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const LIMITE_AVATAR_OCTETS: usize = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Annonce {
    pub id: String,
    pub nom: String,
    pub tcp_port: u16,
    pub version: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Message {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub id: String,
    pub de: String,
    pub vers: String,
    pub texte: String,
    pub ts: i64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub reponse_a: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub piece_jointe: Option<PieceJointe>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Enveloppe {
    Chat {
        id: String,
        de: String,
        vers: String,
        texte: String,
        ts: i64,
        #[serde(default)]
        reponse_a: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        piece_jointe: Option<PieceJointe>,
    },
    DemandeAvatar {
        de: String,
    },
    ReponseAvatar {
        de: String,
        avatar_b64: String,
    },
    SupprimerMessage {
        de: String,
        vers: String,
        id: String,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Pair {
    pub id: String,
    pub nom: String,
    pub adresse: SocketAddr,
    pub tcp_port: u16,
    pub derniere_annonce: Instant,
}

pub enum Evenement {
    PairVu(Pair),
    MessageRecu(Message),
    AvatarRecu { id: String, bytes: Vec<u8> },
    MessageSupprime { de: String, id: String },
}

pub struct Reseau {
    pub evenements: Receiver<Evenement>,
    pub signal_nouveau: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    tx_evenements: Sender<Evenement>,
    signal_rafraichir: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    _gardes: Vec<thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Reseau {
    pub fn demarrer(id_local: String, nom_local: String) -> Option<Self> {
        let bind_udp: SocketAddr = format!("0.0.0.0:{}", PORT_UDP).parse().ok()?;
        let socket_udp = UdpSocket::bind(bind_udp).ok()?;
        socket_udp.set_broadcast(true).ok()?;

        let listener_tcp = TcpListener::bind("0.0.0.0:0").ok()?;
        let tcp_port = listener_tcp.local_addr().ok()?.port();

        let (tx, rx) = channel();
        let pairs_arc: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Pair>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let signal_rafraichir = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let signal_nouveau = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));

        let annonce = Annonce {
            id: id_local.clone(),
            nom: nom_local.clone(),
            tcp_port,
            version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
        };

        let mut gardes = Vec::new();

        gardes.push(spawn_emetteur_udp(
            socket_udp.try_clone().ok()?,
            annonce,
            signal_rafraichir.clone(),
        ));
        gardes.push(spawn_recepteur_udp(
            socket_udp,
            id_local.clone(),
            tx.clone(),
            pairs_arc.clone(),
            signal_nouveau.clone(),
        ));
        gardes.push(spawn_serveur_tcp(
            listener_tcp,
            id_local,
            tx.clone(),
            signal_nouveau.clone(),
        ));

        Some(Self {
            evenements: rx,
            signal_nouveau,
            tx_evenements: tx,
            signal_rafraichir,
            _gardes: gardes,
        })
    }

    pub fn rafraichir(&self) {
        self.signal_rafraichir.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub fn demander_avatar_async(&self, pair: Pair, mon_id: String) {
        let tx = self.tx_evenements.clone();
        let signal = self.signal_nouveau.clone();
        thread::spawn(move || {
            if let Some(bytes) = demander_avatar(&pair, &mon_id) {
                let _ = tx.send(Evenement::AvatarRecu {
                    id: pair.id.clone(),
                    bytes,
                });
                signal.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        });
    }
}

fn adresses_broadcast() -> Vec<SocketAddr> {
    let mut cibles = Vec::new();
    let global: SocketAddr = format!("255.255.255.255:{}", PORT_UDP).parse().unwrap();
    cibles.push(global);
    if let Ok(interfaces) = if_addrs_via_udp() {
        for ip in interfaces {
            if let Some(addr) = broadcast_dirige(ip) {
                cibles.push(SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V4(addr), PORT_UDP));
            }
        }
    }
    cibles
}

fn if_addrs_via_udp() -> Result<Vec<Ipv4Addr>, std::io::Error> {
    let mut adresses = Vec::new();
    let sonde = UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")?;
    if sonde.connect("8.8.8.8:80").is_ok() {
        if let Ok(SocketAddr::V4(addr)) = sonde.local_addr() {
            adresses.push(*addr.ip());
        }
    }
    Ok(adresses)
}

fn broadcast_dirige(ip: Ipv4Addr) -> Option<Ipv4Addr> {
    let octets = ip.octets();
    if octets[0] == 127 || octets[0] == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(Ipv4Addr::new(octets[0], octets[1], octets[2], 255))
}

fn spawn_emetteur_udp(
    socket: UdpSocket,
    annonce: Annonce,
    signal: Arc<AtomicBool>,
) -> thread::JoinHandle<()> {
    thread::spawn(move || {
        let cibles = adresses_broadcast();
        loop {
            if let Ok(texte) = serde_json::to_string(&annonce) {
                for cible in &cibles {
                    let _ = socket.send_to(texte.as_bytes(), cible);
                }
            }
            let mut attendu = Duration::from_millis(200);
            let mut ecoule = Duration::ZERO;
            while ecoule < INTERVALLE_ANNONCE {
                if signal.swap(false, Ordering::Relaxed) {
                    break;
                }
                thread::sleep(attendu);
                ecoule += attendu;
                attendu = Duration::from_millis(500);
            }
        }
    })
}

fn spawn_recepteur_udp(
    socket: UdpSocket,
    id_local: String,
    tx: Sender<Evenement>,
    pairs: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Pair>>>,
    signal_nouveau: Arc<AtomicBool>,
) -> thread::JoinHandle<()> {
    thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut buf = [0u8; 2048];
        loop {
            match socket.recv_from(&mut buf) {
                Ok((n, addr)) => {
                    if let Ok(texte) = std::str::from_utf8(&buf[..n]) {
                        if let Ok(annonce) = serde_json::from_str::<Annonce>(texte) {
                            if annonce.id == id_local {
                                continue;
                            }
                            let pair = Pair {
                                id: annonce.id.clone(),
                                nom: annonce.nom.clone(),
                                adresse: addr,
                                tcp_port: annonce.tcp_port,
                                derniere_annonce: Instant::now(),
                            };
                            {
                                let mut liste = pairs.lock().unwrap();
                                if let Some(existant) = liste.iter_mut().find(|p| p.id == pair.id) {
                                    existant.derniere_annonce = Instant::now();
                                    existant.adresse = addr;
                                    existant.tcp_port = annonce.tcp_port;
                                    existant.nom = annonce.nom;
                                } else {
                                    liste.push(pair.clone());
                                }
                            }
                            let _ = tx.send(Evenement::PairVu(pair));
                            signal_nouveau.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
    })
}

fn spawn_serveur_tcp(
    listener: TcpListener,
    id_local: String,
    tx: Sender<Evenement>,
    signal_nouveau: Arc<AtomicBool>,
) -> thread::JoinHandle<()> {
    thread::spawn(move || {
        for flux in listener.incoming() {
            let Ok(flux) = flux else { continue };
            let tx = tx.clone();
            let id_local = id_local.clone();
            let signal = signal_nouveau.clone();
            thread::spawn(move || {
                traiter_connexion_entrante(flux, &id_local, &tx, &signal);
            });
        }
    })
}

fn traiter_connexion_entrante(
    mut flux: TcpStream,
    id_local: &str,
    tx: &Sender<Evenement>,
    signal: &Arc<AtomicBool>,
) {
    let _ = flux.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(15)));
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    let mut temp = [0u8; 65536];
    loop {
        match flux.read(&mut temp) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(n) => {
                buf.extend_from_slice(&temp[..n]);
                if buf.len() > LIMITE_MESSAGE_OCTETS {
                    return;
                }
                if n < temp.len() {
                    break;
                }
            }
            Err(_) => break,
        }
    }
    if buf.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let Ok(texte) = std::str::from_utf8(&buf) else {
        return;
    };
    let Ok(enveloppe) = serde_json::from_str::<Enveloppe>(texte) else {
        return;
    };
    match enveloppe {
        Enveloppe::Chat {
            id,
            de,
            vers,
            texte,
            ts,
            reponse_a,
            piece_jointe,
        } => {
            if vers == id_local {
                let _ = tx.send(Evenement::MessageRecu(Message {
                    id,
                    de,
                    vers,
                    texte,
                    ts,
                    reponse_a,
                    piece_jointe,
                }));
                signal.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        }
        Enveloppe::DemandeAvatar { de: _ } => {
            if let Some(bytes) = lire_avatar_local() {
                if bytes.len() <= LIMITE_AVATAR_OCTETS {
                    let reponse = Enveloppe::ReponseAvatar {
                        de: id_local.to_string(),
                        avatar_b64: BASE64.encode(&bytes),
                    };
                    if let Ok(txt) = serde_json::to_string(&reponse) {
                        let _ = flux.write_all(txt.as_bytes());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Enveloppe::ReponseAvatar { de, avatar_b64 } => {
            if let Ok(bytes) = BASE64.decode(avatar_b64.as_bytes()) {
                if bytes.len() <= LIMITE_AVATAR_OCTETS {
                    let _ = tx.send(Evenement::AvatarRecu { id: de, bytes });
                    signal.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                }
            }
        }
        Enveloppe::SupprimerMessage { de, vers, id } => {
            if vers == id_local {
                let _ = tx.send(Evenement::MessageSupprime { de, id });
                signal.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn lire_avatar_local() -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    std::fs::read(crate::persistence::chemin_avatar()).ok()
}

pub fn envoyer_message_tcp(pair: &Pair, message: &Message) -> bool {
    let enveloppe = Enveloppe::Chat {
        id: message.id.clone(),
        de: message.de.clone(),
        vers: message.vers.clone(),
        texte: message.texte.clone(),
        ts: message.ts,
        reponse_a: message.reponse_a.clone(),
        piece_jointe: message.piece_jointe.clone(),
    };
    envoyer_enveloppe(pair, &enveloppe)
}

pub fn envoyer_suppression(pair: &Pair, de: &str, id: &str) -> bool {
    let enveloppe = Enveloppe::SupprimerMessage {
        de: de.to_string(),
        vers: pair.id.clone(),
        id: id.to_string(),
    };
    envoyer_enveloppe(pair, &enveloppe)
}

pub fn demander_avatar(pair: &Pair, de: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let addr = format!("{}:{}", pair.adresse.ip(), pair.tcp_port);
    let mut flux = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr.parse().ok()?, Duration::from_secs(2)).ok()?;
    let _ = flux.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5)));
    let enveloppe = Enveloppe::DemandeAvatar { de: de.to_string() };
    let texte = serde_json::to_string(&enveloppe).ok()?;
    flux.write_all(texte.as_bytes()).ok()?;
    flux.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write).ok()?;
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; LIMITE_AVATAR_OCTETS + 1024];
    let mut total = 0usize;
    loop {
        match flux.read(&mut buf[total..]) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(n) => {
                total += n;
                if total >= buf.len() {
                    break;
                }
            }
            Err(_) => break,
        }
    }
    if total == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let texte = std::str::from_utf8(&buf[..total]).ok()?;
    let enveloppe = serde_json::from_str::<Enveloppe>(texte).ok()?;
    match enveloppe {
        Enveloppe::ReponseAvatar { avatar_b64, .. } => BASE64.decode(avatar_b64.as_bytes()).ok(),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn envoyer_enveloppe(pair: &Pair, enveloppe: &Enveloppe) -> bool {
    let addr = format!("{}:{}", pair.adresse.ip(), pair.tcp_port);
    let Ok(mut flux) = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr.parse().unwrap(), Duration::from_secs(5))
    else {
        return false;
    };
    let Ok(texte) = serde_json::to_string(enveloppe) else {
        return false;
    };
    if flux.write_all(texte.as_bytes()).is_err() {
        return false;
    }
    let _ = flux.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write);
    true
}

--- FICHIER : D:\Creation\Rust\Joinus\src\peers.rs ---
use crate::network::Pair;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub struct ListePairs {
    pairs: HashMap<String, Pair>,
    avatars: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}

impl ListePairs {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            pairs: HashMap::new(),
            avatars: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn ajouter_ou_mettre_a_jour(&mut self, pair: Pair) {
        if let Some(existant) = self.pairs.get_mut(&pair.id) {
            existant.nom = pair.nom;
            existant.adresse = pair.adresse;
            existant.tcp_port = pair.tcp_port;
            existant.derniere_annonce = Instant::now();
        } else {
            self.pairs.insert(pair.id.clone(), pair);
        }
    }

    #[allow(dead_code)]
    pub fn retirer(&mut self, id: &str) {
        self.pairs.remove(id);
        self.avatars.remove(id);
    }

    pub fn retirer_inactifs(&mut self, duree: Duration) -> Vec<String> {
        let maintenant = Instant::now();
        let perdus: Vec<String> = self
            .pairs
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, p)| maintenant.duration_since(p.derniere_annonce) > duree)
            .map(|(id, _)| id.clone())
            .collect();
        for id in &perdus {
            self.pairs.remove(id);
            self.avatars.remove(id);
        }
        perdus
    }

    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Pair> {
        self.pairs.values()
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&Pair> {
        self.pairs.get(id)
    }

    pub fn avatar(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&Vec<u8>> {
        self.avatars.get(id)
    }

    pub fn definir_avatar(&mut self, id: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) {
        self.avatars.insert(id.to_string(), bytes);
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.pairs.len()
    }

    #[allow(dead_code)]
    pub fn trier_par_nom(&self) -> Vec<&Pair> {
        let mut v: Vec<&Pair> = self.pairs.values().collect();
        v.sort_by(|a, b| a.nom.to_lowercase().cmp(&b.nom.to_lowercase()));
        v
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::net::SocketAddr;

    fn pair_test(id: &str, nom: &str) -> Pair {
        Pair {
            id: id.to_string(),
            nom: nom.to_string(),
            adresse: "127.0.0.1:0".parse::<SocketAddr>().unwrap(),
            tcp_port: 0,
            derniere_annonce: Instant::now(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ajouter_mettre_a_jour() {
        let mut lp = ListePairs::new();
        lp.ajouter_ou_mettre_a_jour(pair_test("a", "Alice"));
        lp.ajouter_ou_mettre_a_jour(pair_test("a", "Alicia"));
        assert_eq!(lp.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(lp.get("a").unwrap().nom, "Alicia");
    }

    #[test]
    fn retirer_supprime_avatar() {
        let mut lp = ListePairs::new();
        lp.definir_avatar("a", vec![1, 2, 3]);
        lp.retirer("a");
        assert!(lp.avatar("a").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn retirer_inactifs() {
        let mut lp = ListePairs::new();
        lp.ajouter_ou_mettre_a_jour(pair_test("a", "Alice"));
        let perdus = lp.retirer_inactifs(Duration::from_secs(0));
        assert_eq!(perdus, vec!["a".to_string()]);
        assert_eq!(lp.len(), 0);
    }
}

use crate::i18n::Langue;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct Session {
    pub nom_affiche: String,
    pub langue: Langue,
    pub sombre: bool,
    #[serde(default = "taille_fenetre_defaut")]
    pub window_size: [f32; 2],
    #[serde(default = "id_defaut")]
    pub id: String,
}

fn taille_fenetre_defaut() -> [f32; 2] {
    [1150.0, 720.0]
}

fn id_defaut() -> String {
    Uuid::new_v4().to_string()
}

impl Default for Session {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            nom_affiche: "Utilisateur".to_string(),
            langue: Langue::Fr,
            sombre: true,
            window_size: taille_fenetre_defaut(),
            id: id_defaut(),
        }
    }
}

pub fn dossier_app() -> PathBuf {
    if let Ok(appdata) = std::env::var("APPDATA") {
        let p = PathBuf::from(appdata).join("Joinus");
        if std::fs::create_dir_all(&p).is_ok() {
            return p;
        }
    }
    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join("Joinus");
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&p);
    p
}

pub fn dossier_historique() -> PathBuf {
    let p = dossier_app().join("historique");
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&p);
    p
}

fn chemin_session() -> PathBuf {
    dossier_app().join("session.json")
}

pub fn charger_session() -> Session {
    let chemin = chemin_session();
    if let Ok(texte) = std::fs::read_to_string(&chemin) {
        if let Ok(s) = serde_json::from_str::<Session>(&texte) {
            return s;
        }
    }
    Session::default()
}

pub fn sauver_session(session: &Session) {
    let chemin = chemin_session();
    if let Ok(texte) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(session) {
        let _ = std::fs::write(chemin, texte);
    }
}

pub fn chemin_avatar() -> PathBuf {
    dossier_app().join("avatar.dat")
}

pub fn charger_avatar() -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let bytes = std::fs::read(chemin_avatar()).ok()?;
    if image::load_from_memory(&bytes).is_err() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(bytes)
}

pub fn sauver_avatar(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    std::fs::write(chemin_avatar(), bytes).is_ok()
}

fn chemin_alias() -> PathBuf {
    dossier_app().join("alias.json")
}

pub fn charger_alias() -> HashMap<String, String> {
    if let Ok(texte) = std::fs::read_to_string(chemin_alias()) {
        if let Ok(m) = serde_json::from_str::<HashMap<String, String>>(&texte) {
            return m;
        }
    }
    HashMap::new()
}

pub fn sauver_alias(alias: &HashMap<String, String>) {
    if let Ok(texte) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(alias) {
        let _ = std::fs::write(chemin_alias(), texte);
    }
}

pub fn supprimer_historique(pair_id: &str) {
    let chemin = dossier_historique().join(format!("{}.json", pair_id));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(chemin);
}

        assert_eq!(s.langue, Langue::Fr);
        assert!(s.sombre);
        assert!(!s.id.is_empty());
    }

            langue: Langue::En,

        let s2: Session = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.nom_affiche, s2.nom_affiche);
        assert_eq!(s.id, s2.id);
    }
}

--- FICHIER : D:\Creation\Rust\Joinus\src\pieces_jointes.rs ---
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as BASE64, Engine};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::path::Path;

pub const LIMITE_PIECE_OCTETS: usize = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct PieceJointe {
    pub nom: String,
    pub mime: String,
    pub donnees_b64: String,
}

impl PieceJointe {
    pub fn depuis_fichier(chemin: &Path) -> Result<Self, ErreurPiece> {
        let bytes = std::fs::read(chemin).map_err(|_| ErreurPiece::Lecture)?;
        if bytes.len() > LIMITE_PIECE_OCTETS {
            return Err(ErreurPiece::Taille);
        }
        let nom = chemin
            .file_name()
            .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
            .unwrap_or("fichier")
            .to_string();
        let mime = deviner_mime(&nom);
        Ok(Self {
            nom,
            mime,
            donnees_b64: BASE64.encode(&bytes),
        })
    }

    pub fn decoder(&self) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        BASE64.decode(self.donnees_b64.as_bytes()).ok()
    }

    pub fn est_image(&self) -> bool {
        self.mime.starts_with("image/")
    }

    pub fn taille_octets(&self) -> usize {
        self.donnees_b64.len() * 3 / 4
    }
}

pub enum ErreurPiece {
    Lecture,
    Taille,
}

fn deviner_mime(nom: &str) -> String {
    let bas = nom.to_lowercase();
    if bas.ends_with(".png") {
        "image/png".to_string()
    } else if bas.ends_with(".jpg") || bas.ends_with(".jpeg") {
        "image/jpeg".to_string()
    } else if bas.ends_with(".gif") {
        "image/gif".to_string()
    } else if bas.ends_with(".webp") {
        "image/webp".to_string()
    } else if bas.ends_with(".pdf") {
        "application/pdf".to_string()
    } else if bas.ends_with(".txt") {
        "text/plain".to_string()
    } else if bas.ends_with(".zip") {
        "application/zip".to_string()
    } else {
        "application/octet-stream".to_string()
    }
}

--- FICHIER : D:\Creation\Rust\Joinus\src\profile.rs ---
use crate::persistence::{self, Session};
use crate::theme::CacheTextures;
use eframe::egui;

pub enum ErreurAvatar {
    Lecture,
    Taille,
    Format,
    Ecriture,
}

pub struct Profil {
    pub nom: String,
    pub avatar_bytes: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub avatar_hash: u64,
    pub erreur: Option<ErreurAvatar>,
}

impl Profil {
    pub fn charger(session: &Session) -> Self {
        let avatar_bytes = persistence::charger_avatar();
        let avatar_hash = avatar_bytes
            .as_ref()
            .map(|b| crate::theme::hash_bytes(b))
            .unwrap_or(0);
        Self {
            nom: session.nom_affiche.clone(),
            avatar_bytes,
            avatar_hash,
            erreur: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn importer_avatar(&mut self) {
        let choix = rfd::FileDialog::new()
            .add_filter("Images", &["png", "jpg", "jpeg"])
            .pick_file();
        let Some(chemin) = choix else {
            return;
        };
        let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&chemin) else {
            self.erreur = Some(ErreurAvatar::Lecture);
            return;
        };
        if bytes.len() > 5 * 1024 * 1024 {
            self.erreur = Some(ErreurAvatar::Taille);
            return;
        }
        let Ok(img) = image::load_from_memory(&bytes) else {
            self.erreur = Some(ErreurAvatar::Format);
            return;
        };
        let carre = recadrer_carre(img);
        let mut buffer = std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new());
        let encodeur = image::codecs::png::PngEncoder::new(&mut buffer);
        use image::ImageEncoder;
        let (w, h) = carre.dimensions();
        if encodeur
            .write_image(carre.as_raw(), w, h, image::ExtendedColorType::Rgba8)
            .is_err()
        {
            self.erreur = Some(ErreurAvatar::Ecriture);
            return;
        }
        let bytes_carres = buffer.into_inner();
        if persistence::sauver_avatar(&bytes_carres) {
            self.avatar_hash = crate::theme::hash_bytes(&bytes_carres);
            self.avatar_bytes = Some(bytes_carres);
            self.erreur = None;
        } else {
            self.erreur = Some(ErreurAvatar::Ecriture);
        }
    }

    pub fn texture(
        &self,
        ctx: &egui::Context,
        cache: &mut CacheTextures,
    ) -> Option<egui::TextureHandle> {
        let bytes = self.avatar_bytes.as_ref()?;
        cache.obtenir_avec_hash(ctx, bytes, self.avatar_hash, "avatar")
    }

    pub fn initiale(&self) -> Option<char> {
        self.nom.chars().find(|c| !c.is_whitespace())
    }
}

fn recadrer_carre(img: image::DynamicImage) -> image::RgbaImage {
    let rgba = img.to_rgba8();
    let (w, h) = rgba.dimensions();
    let cote = w.min(h);
    let x = (w - cote) / 2;
    let y = (h - cote) / 2;
    image::imageops::crop_imm(&rgba, x, y, cote, cote).to_image()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn recadrer_carre_image_carree() {
        let img = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(image::RgbaImage::new(100, 100));
        let carre = recadrer_carre(img);
        assert_eq!(carre.dimensions(), (100, 100));
    }

    #[test]
    fn recadrer_carre_image_paysage() {
        let img = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(image::RgbaImage::new(200, 100));
        let carre = recadrer_carre(img);
        assert_eq!(carre.dimensions(), (100, 100));
    }

    #[test]
    fn recadrer_carre_image_portrait() {
        let img = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(image::RgbaImage::new(100, 200));
        let carre = recadrer_carre(img);
        assert_eq!(carre.dimensions(), (100, 100));
    }
}

use eframe::egui;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::Path;

pub const FOND: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x13, 0x15, 0x14);
pub const TEXTE: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xe9, 0xea, 0xe5);
pub const SURFACE: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xf7, 0xf7, 0xf5);
pub const SECONDAIRE: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x69, 0x6a, 0x65);
pub const ERREUR: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xc0, 0x50, 0x50);
pub const ONLINE: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x2E, 0xA0, 0x43);
pub const NOTIFICATION: egui::Color32 = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xD0, 0x50, 0x50);

pub const ESPACE_S: f32 = 6.0;
pub const ESPACE_M: f32 = 12.0;
pub const ESPACE_L: f32 = 18.0;
pub const ESPACE_XL: f32 = 24.0;

pub const AVATAR_TAILLE: f32 = 108.0;
pub const AVATAR_LISTE_TAILLE: f32 = 40.0;
pub const CARTE_PAIR_HAUTEUR: f32 = 58.0;
pub const CARTE_PAIR_ROUNDING: f32 = 10.0;
pub const CHAMP_SAISIE_HAUTEUR: f32 = 90.0;
pub const LIMITE_MESSAGE: usize = 4096;
pub const BOUTON_ENVOYER_LARGEUR: f32 = 110.0;
pub const BOUTON_ENVOYER_HAUTEUR: f32 = 40.0;
pub const BOUTON_ENVOYER_ICONE: f32 = 30.0;
pub const BOUTON_RAFRAICHIR_TAILLE: f32 = 32.0;
pub const BOUTON_RAFRAICHIR_ICONE: f32 = 22.0;
pub const BOUTON_THEME_TAILLE: f32 = 32.0;
pub const BOUTON_THEME_ICONE: f32 = 22.0;

pub fn carte_pair_fond(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x1c, 0x1e, 0x1c)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xea, 0xea, 0xe6)
    }
}

pub fn carte_pair_fond_survol(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x2a, 0x2d, 0x2a)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xdd, 0xde, 0xd9)
    }
}

pub fn carte_pair_fond_actif(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x3a, 0x3d, 0x3a)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xcf, 0xd0, 0xcb)
    }
}

pub fn bulle_moi(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x2a, 0x2d, 0x2a)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xd8, 0xd9, 0xd4)
    }
}

pub fn bulle_autre(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x1c, 0x1e, 0x1c)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xe9, 0xea, 0xe5)
    }
}

pub fn fond_avatar(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x3a, 0x3d, 0x3a)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xcf, 0xd0, 0xcb)
    }
}

pub fn popup_fond(sombre: bool) -> egui::Color32 {
    if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x24, 0x27, 0x24)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xff, 0xff, 0xff)
    }
}

pub fn hash_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf29ce484222325;
    for b in bytes {
        h ^= *b as u64;
        h = h.wrapping_mul(0x100000001b3);
    }
    h
}

pub struct CacheTextures {
    entrees: HashMap<u64, egui::TextureHandle>,
}

impl CacheTextures {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            entrees: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn obtenir_avec_hash(
        &mut self,
        ctx: &egui::Context,
        bytes: &[u8],
        hash: u64,
        nom: &str,
    ) -> Option<egui::TextureHandle> {
        if let Some(t) = self.entrees.get(&hash) {
            return Some(t.clone());
        }
        let img = image::load_from_memory(bytes).ok()?.to_rgba8();
        let (w, h) = img.dimensions();
        let couleur =
            egui::ColorImage::from_rgba_unmultiplied([w as usize, h as usize], img.as_raw());
        let handle = ctx.load_texture(
            nom,
            couleur,
            egui::TextureOptions {
                magnification: egui::TextureFilter::Linear,
                minification: egui::TextureFilter::Linear,
                wrap_mode: egui::TextureWrapMode::ClampToEdge,
            },
        );
        self.entrees.insert(hash, handle.clone());
        Some(handle)
    }
}

pub fn charger_texture_fichier(
    ctx: &egui::Context,
    chemin: &Path,
    nom: &str,
) -> Option<egui::TextureHandle> {
    let bytes = std::fs::read(chemin).ok()?;
    let img = image::load_from_memory(&bytes).ok()?;
    let img = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(img.to_rgba8());
    let (w, h) = (img.width(), img.height());
    let cote_min = w.min(h);
    let img = if cote_min < 32 {
        let cible = 64u32;
        let ratio = cible as f32 / cote_min as f32;
        let nw = (w as f32 * ratio).round() as u32;
        let nh = (h as f32 * ratio).round() as u32;
        img.resize(nw, nh, image::imageops::FilterType::Lanczos3)
    } else {
        img
    };
    let rgba = img.to_rgba8();
    let (w, h) = rgba.dimensions();
    let couleur = egui::ColorImage::from_rgba_unmultiplied([w as usize, h as usize], rgba.as_raw());
    Some(ctx.load_texture(
        nom,
        couleur,
        egui::TextureOptions {
            magnification: egui::TextureFilter::Linear,
            minification: egui::TextureFilter::Linear,
            wrap_mode: egui::TextureWrapMode::ClampToEdge,
        },
    ))
}

pub fn appliquer_theme(ctx: &egui::Context, sombre: bool) {
    let mut visuels = if sombre {
        egui::Visuals::dark()
    } else {
        egui::Visuals::light()
    };

    if sombre {
        visuels.panel_fill = FOND;
        visuels.window_fill = FOND;
        visuels.extreme_bg_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x0a, 0x0b, 0x0a);
        visuels.faint_bg_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x1c, 0x1e, 0x1c);
        visuels.override_text_color = Some(TEXTE);
        visuels.widgets.noninteractive.bg_stroke.color = SECONDAIRE;
        visuels.widgets.inactive.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x1c, 0x1e, 0x1c);
        visuels.widgets.inactive.weak_bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x1c, 0x1e, 0x1c);
        visuels.widgets.inactive.fg_stroke.color = TEXTE;
        visuels.widgets.hovered.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x2a, 0x2d, 0x2a);
        visuels.widgets.hovered.weak_bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x2a, 0x2d, 0x2a);
        visuels.widgets.hovered.fg_stroke.color = TEXTE;
        visuels.widgets.active.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x3a, 0x3d, 0x3a);
        visuels.widgets.active.weak_bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x3a, 0x3d, 0x3a);
        visuels.widgets.active.fg_stroke.color = TEXTE;
        visuels.selection.bg_fill = SECONDAIRE;
        visuels.selection.stroke.color = TEXTE;
        visuels.hyperlink_color = SURFACE;
    } else {
        visuels.panel_fill = SURFACE;
        visuels.window_fill = SURFACE;
        visuels.extreme_bg_color = egui::Color32::WHITE;
        visuels.faint_bg_color = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xe9, 0xea, 0xe5);
        visuels.override_text_color = Some(FOND);
        visuels.widgets.noninteractive.bg_stroke.color = SECONDAIRE;
        visuels.widgets.inactive.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xea, 0xea, 0xe6);
        visuels.widgets.inactive.weak_bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xea, 0xea, 0xe6);
        visuels.widgets.inactive.fg_stroke.color = FOND;
        visuels.widgets.hovered.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xdd, 0xde, 0xd9);
        visuels.widgets.hovered.weak_bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xdd, 0xde, 0xd9);
        visuels.widgets.hovered.fg_stroke.color = FOND;
        visuels.widgets.active.bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xcf, 0xd0, 0xcb);
        visuels.widgets.active.weak_bg_fill = egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xcf, 0xd0, 0xcb);
        visuels.widgets.active.fg_stroke.color = FOND;
        visuels.selection.bg_fill = SECONDAIRE;
        visuels.selection.stroke.color = SURFACE;
        visuels.hyperlink_color = SECONDAIRE;
    }
    visuels.window_rounding = egui::Rounding::same(10.0);
    visuels.menu_rounding = egui::Rounding::same(10.0);
    ctx.set_visuals(visuels);
}

pub fn bouton_icone(
    ui: &mut egui::Ui,
    taille: f32,
    icone: f32,
    texture: Option<&egui::TextureHandle>,
    sombre: bool,
    fallback: &str,
) -> egui::Response {
    let (rect, reponse) = ui.allocate_exact_size(egui::vec2(taille, taille), egui::Sense::click());
    let style = ui.style().interact(&reponse);
    ui.painter()
        .rect_filled(rect, egui::Rounding::same(8.0), style.weak_bg_fill);
    let couleur_fallback = if sombre { TEXTE } else { FOND };
    if let Some(tex) = texture {
        let zone = egui::Rect::from_center_size(rect.center(), egui::vec2(icone, icone));
        ui.painter().image(
            tex.id(),
            zone,
            egui::Rect::from_min_max(egui::pos2(0.0, 0.0), egui::pos2(1.0, 1.0)),
            egui::Color32::WHITE,
        );
    } else {
        ui.painter().text(
            rect.center(),
            egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER,
            fallback,
            egui::FontId::proportional(taille * 0.45),
            couleur_fallback,
        );
    }
    reponse
}

pub fn bouton_action(
    ui: &mut egui::Ui,
    icone: Option<&egui::TextureHandle>,
    texte: &str,
    sombre: bool,
) -> egui::Response {
    let couleur_texte = if sombre { TEXTE } else { FOND };
    let couleur_fond = if sombre {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x2a, 0x2d, 0x2a)
    } else {
        egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xea, 0xea, 0xe6)
    };
    let padding = egui::vec2(10.0, 7.0);
    let hauteur = 32.0;
    let largeur = ui.available_width();
    let (rect, reponse) = ui.allocate_exact_size(
        egui::vec2(largeur.min(220.0), hauteur),
        egui::Sense::click(),
    );
    let fond = if reponse.hovered() {
        if sombre {
            egui::Color32::from_rgb(0x3a, 0x3d, 0x3a)
        } else {
            egui::Color32::from_rgb(0xdd, 0xde, 0xd9)
        }
    } else {
        couleur_fond
    };
    ui.painter()
        .rect_filled(rect, egui::Rounding::same(8.0), fond);
    let mut x = rect.left() + padding.x;
    if let Some(tex) = icone {
        let zone = egui::Rect::from_min_size(
            egui::pos2(x, rect.center().y - 9.0),
            egui::vec2(18.0, 18.0),
        );
        ui.painter().image(
            tex.id(),
            zone,
            egui::Rect::from_min_max(egui::pos2(0.0, 0.0), egui::pos2(1.0, 1.0)),
            egui::Color32::WHITE,
        );
        x += 18.0 + 8.0;
    }
    ui.painter().text(
        egui::pos2(x, rect.center().y),
        egui::Align2::LEFT_CENTER,
        texte,
        egui::FontId::proportional(13.0),
        couleur_texte,
    );
    reponse.on_hover_cursor(egui::CursorIcon::PointingHand)
}

pub fn bouton_tricolore(
    ui: &mut egui::Ui,
    texture: Option<&egui::TextureHandle>,
    couleur_fond: egui::Color32,
    fallback: &str,
    taille: f32,
) -> egui::Response {
    let (rect, reponse) = ui.allocate_exact_size(egui::vec2(taille, taille), egui::Sense::click());
    let fond = if reponse.hovered() {
        let a = couleur_fond.a();
        let r = couleur_fond.r().saturating_add(20);
        let g = couleur_fond.g().saturating_add(20);
        let b = couleur_fond.b().saturating_add(20);
        egui::Color32::from_rgba_unmultiplied(r, g, b, a)
    } else {
        couleur_fond
    };
    ui.painter()
        .rect_filled(rect, egui::Rounding::same(8.0), fond);
    if let Some(tex) = texture {
        let zone = egui::Rect::from_center_size(
            rect.center(),
            egui::vec2(taille * 0.55, taille * 0.55),
        );
        ui.painter().image(
            tex.id(),
            zone,
            egui::Rect::from_min_max(egui::pos2(0.0, 0.0), egui::pos2(1.0, 1.0)),
            egui::Color32::WHITE,
        );
    } else {
        ui.painter().text(
            rect.center(),
            egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER,
            fallback,
            egui::FontId::proportional(taille * 0.42),
            egui::Color32::WHITE,
        );
    }
    reponse.on_hover_cursor(egui::CursorIcon::PointingHand)
}

fn mesh_disque(
    texture: &egui::TextureHandle,
    centre: egui::Pos2,
    rayon: f32,
    segments: usize,
) -> egui::Mesh {
    let mut mesh = egui::Mesh::with_texture(texture.id());
    let centre_idx = mesh.vertices.len() as u32;
    mesh.vertices.push(egui::epaint::Vertex {
        pos: centre,
        uv: egui::pos2(0.5, 0.5),
        color: egui::Color32::WHITE,
    });
    for i in 0..segments {
        let angle = (i as f32 / segments as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;
        mesh.vertices.push(egui::epaint::Vertex {
            pos: centre + egui::vec2(angle.cos(), angle.sin()) * rayon,
            uv: egui::pos2(0.5 + 0.5 * angle.cos(), 0.5 + 0.5 * angle.sin()),
            color: egui::Color32::WHITE,
        });
    }
    for i in 0..segments {
        let a = centre_idx + 1 + i as u32;
        let b = centre_idx + 1 + ((i + 1) % segments) as u32;
        mesh.indices.push(centre_idx);
        mesh.indices.push(a);
        mesh.indices.push(b);
    }
    mesh
}

pub fn dessiner_avatar_arrondi(
    ui: &egui::Ui,
    rect: egui::Rect,
    texture: Option<&egui::TextureHandle>,
    initiale: Option<char>,
    sombre: bool,
) {
    let painter = ui.painter();
    let centre = rect.center();
    let rayon = rect.width().min(rect.height()) / 2.0;
    let couleur_texte = if sombre { TEXTE } else { FOND };
    painter.circle_filled(centre, rayon, fond_avatar(sombre));
    if let Some(tex) = texture {
        painter.add(egui::Shape::mesh(mesh_disque(tex, centre, rayon, 64)));
    } else {
        let texte = initiale
            .map(|c| c.to_uppercase().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "?".to_string());
        painter.text(
            centre,
            egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER,
            texte,
            egui::FontId::proportional(rayon * 0.9),
            couleur_texte,
        );
    }
    painter.circle_stroke(centre, rayon, egui::Stroke::new(2.0_f32, couleur_texte));
}

pub fn dessiner_avatar_petit(
    ui: &egui::Ui,
    rect: egui::Rect,
    texture: Option<&egui::TextureHandle>,
    initiale: Option<char>,
    couleur_texte: egui::Color32,
    sombre: bool,
) {
    let painter = ui.painter();
    let centre = rect.center();
    let rayon = rect.width().min(rect.height()) / 2.0;
    painter.circle_filled(centre, rayon, fond_avatar(sombre));
    if let Some(tex) = texture {
        painter.add(egui::Shape::mesh(mesh_disque(tex, centre, rayon, 32)));
    } else {
        let texte = initiale
            .map(|c| c.to_uppercase().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "?".to_string());
        painter.text(
            centre,
            egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER,
            texte,
            egui::FontId::proportional(rayon * 1.1),
            couleur_texte,
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn hash_bytes_deterministe() {
        assert_eq!(hash_bytes(b"abc"), hash_bytes(b"abc"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn hash_bytes_vide() {
        assert_eq!(hash_bytes(b""), 0xcbf29ce484222325);
    }
}
